title: GENARCH Annual Report 2026: Atlas Scope, Methods, and an Independent Reprocessing of Virginia DEQ Data Center Air Monitoring Project Sensor Data
deqCredit: Sensor data: Virginia Department of Environmental Quality, Data Center Air Monitoring Project.
note: Read by the report route and by pipeline/report_pdf_post.py, which is why it is JSON rather than a TypeScript object: the PDF metadata and the page metadata must come from one file, and the post-processor cannot parse TypeScript. Both PENDING fields suppress their metadata tag until a real identifier replaces them, and --final refuses to build while either is PENDING.
